scope: Ground-supported reuse of original recovery animations, articulated/procedural arm protection, reciprocal training contact and bounded shirt shell. No new full-match rotoscoping corpus.

new_reference.studied: Mesh edge constraints, pinned particles, compliance over dt squared, substeps. Independent game-specific C++ shell implementation.

limits: The two earlier short real-kick sequences were studied; new match video was not reconstructed into 3D motion.
Procedural variations reuse native poses; they are not hundreds of independently captured animation clips.
The cloth is a low-resolution bounded shirt shell, not a measured textile model.
Get-up uses authored animation and skin-ground alignment, not a learned physical policy.
